name: 94709 · Berkeley, CA
findings: ZIP 94709 (Berkeley) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94709 (Berkeley) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94709 (Berkeley) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
